description: How your accounts and your competitors post and perform over their last 90 days: pace, typical views, views per follower, public engagement, formats, video length, hashtags, usual posting time, and their top posts (each with an id and a picture), plus up to six plain-language takeaways. Engagement here counts only likes and comments, the numbers that are public on both sides. takeaway_tiles pairs each takeaway with the competitor's post that shows it (a picture, its numbers) and the one thing to do about it. next_steps holds the takeaways a call can act on, best first: each apply is the exact call to make (tool and input), and needs names what the person still gives (a series name, media).

account_id.description: Compare competitors with this account instead of each one's own. Only those on the same network are compared with it; the others come back with skipped

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: competitors_compare
title: Compare with competitors
